title: Rambunctious Recitation
description: Play a Van Eck-like memory game, simulating spoken numbers to turn 30 million.
writeup:
## Approach

A number-speaking game where each turn depends on when the previous number was last spoken. This is essentially a Van Eck sequence.

## Part 1

Track the last turn each number was spoken in a dictionary. On each turn, if the previous number was spoken before, say the difference between the current turn and when it was last seen; otherwise say 0. Simulate to turn 2020.

## Part 2

Same logic but simulate to turn 30,000,000. The key optimization is using a dictionary (hash map) for O(1) lookups rather than scanning a list. Python handles 30M iterations in a few seconds with this approach.
